blocks.prompt: 1 (i) Find remainder and quotient by simplifying the following: \((3x^{2} - x + 2) \div (x - 1)\)
blocks.explanation:
Yeh sawal waisa hi hai jaise hum bachpan mein numbers ki long division karte the, jaise \(17 \div 5\) mein quotient 3 aur remainder 2 aata hai. Bas yahan numbers ki jagah polynomials hain.
Diya kya hai? Dividend (jis ko divide karna hai) \(3x^{2} - x + 2\) aur divisor (jis se divide karna hai) \(x - 1\), jis ki degree 1 hai.
Find kya karna hai? Quotient (division ka jawab) aur remainder (jo aakhir mein bach jaye).
Plan: powers ko tarteeb se likhna, phir teen qadam baar baar: divide, multiply, subtract. Jab bacha hua hissa degree 1 se chhota ho jaye to ruk jana, woh remainder hai.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: dividend \(3x^{2} - x + 2\), divisor \(x - 1\).
Humein find karna hai: quotient aur remainder.
Tareeqa: Long division. Pehli term ko pehli term se divide karna, jawab ko poore divisor se multiply karna, phir subtract karna; yeh chakkar tab tak chalega jab tak bache hue hisse ki degree divisor ki degree 1 se kam na ho jaye. Aakhir mein jawab is rule par poora utrega: Dividend = Divisor × Quotient + Remainder. Isi rule se hum aakhir mein apna jawab check bhi karenge.

Dividend aur divisor ko tarteeb se dekhein
\[3x^{2} - x + 2\]
\[x - 1\]
Kyun: Long division se pehle hamesha check karein ke powers bari se chhoti ki taraf likhi hon aur koi power ghaib na ho. Yahan dono polynomials pehle se tarteeb mein hain aur har power mojood hai, is liye seedha division shuru kar sakte hain. Har power ka apna column hoga, bilkul numbers ki ikaai aur dahaai ki tarah.

Round 1: quotient ki agli term \(3x\)
Divide, multiply, subtract:
\[\dfrac{3x^{2}}{x} = 3x\]
\[3x(x - 1)\]
\[= 3x^{2} - 3x\]
\[3x^{2} - x + 2\]
\[-(3x^{2} - 3x)\]
\[= 2x + 2\]
Kyun: Dividend ki pehli term \(3x^{2}\) ko divisor ki pehli term \(x\) se divide kiya to \(3x\) mila; yeh quotient ki pehli term hai. Isi ko poore divisor se multiply kar ke neeche likha, taake subtract karne par sab se bari power \(x^{2}\) khatam ho jaye. Subtract karte waqt bracket ki har term ka sign badal jata hai, yani minus ke baad bracket khulta hai to plus minus aur minus plus ban jata hai.
Dhyan dein: Sirf pehli term ka sign badal kar baqi bhool jana sab se aam ghalti hai; isi liye hum product ko bracket mein likh kar poora subtract karte hain.

Round 2: quotient ki agli term \(2\)
Divide, multiply, subtract:
\[\dfrac{2x}{x} = 2\]
\[2(x - 1)\]
\[= 2x - 2\]
\[2x + 2\]
\[-(2x - 2)\]
\[= 4\]
Kyun: Pichhle round ke baad jo bacha us ki degree 1 hai, jo divisor ki degree 1 se kam nahi, is liye division abhi khatam nahi hua. Wohi teen kaam dobara: bachi hui pehli term \(2x\) ko \(x\) se divide kiya to \(2\) mila, phir poore divisor se multiply aur phir subtract. Signs ka khaas khayal rakhein: minus ke saath bracket khulne par andar ki har term ka sign ulat jata hai.
Ab jo bacha, \(4\), us ki degree 0 hai, jo divisor ki degree 1 se kam hai. Is ko mazeed divide nahi kar sakte, is liye yahi remainder hai aur division yahan ruk jata hai.

Poori division ko exam wale layout mein likhein
\[\begin{array}{rrrr}  &  & 3x & +\,2 \\ x - 1\,\big) & \overline{3x^{2}} & \overline{-\,x} & \overline{+\,2} \\  & \underline{\pm 3x^{2}} & \underline{\mp 3x} &  \\  &  & 2x & +\,2 \\  &  & \underline{\pm 2x} & \underline{\mp 2} \\  &  &  & 4 \end{array}\]
Kyun: Exam mein upar wale saare rounds isi tarah ek hi layout mein likhe jate hain: upar quotient, line ke neeche dividend, aur har round ka product us ke neeche. Product ki har term ke saath \(\pm\) ya \(\mp\) likhte hain: upar wala sign product ka asal sign hai aur neeche wala sign woh hai jo subtract karte waqt ban jata hai. Is se signs badalna bhoolta nahi.

Quotient aur remainder parhein
\[\text{Quotient} = 3x + 2\]
\[\text{Remainder} = 4\]
Kyun: Layout mein sab se upar wali line quotient hai, kyunke har round mein hum ne usi mein ek term jori thi. Sab se neeche wali line ki degree divisor ki degree se kam hai, is liye woh remainder hai. Yaad rakhein: remainder ki degree hamesha divisor ki degree se kam hoti hai; agar barabar ya zyada ho to division adhoora hai.

Tasdeeq: Divisor × Quotient + Remainder
\[(x - 1)(3x + 2)\]
\[= 3x^{2} - x - 2\]
\[\text{add } 4:\]
\[= 3x^{2} - x + 2 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Division ka bunyadi rule hai: Dividend = Divisor × Quotient + Remainder, bilkul jaise \(17 = 5 \times 3 + 2\). Hum ne divisor ko quotient se multiply kiya, remainder joda, aur wapas asal dividend \(3x^{2} - x + 2\) mil gaya. Is ka matlab hai ke hamara jawab bilkul sahi hai. Exam mein yeh check do minute leta hai lekin poore marks bacha leta hai.

\[\dfrac{25x}{x} = 25\]

blocks.prompt: 1 (iv) Find remainder and quotient by simplifying the following: \((5x^{4} - 3x^{3} + 2x^{2} - 1) \div (x^{2} + 4)\)

\[= -18x^{2} - 72\]
\[-18x^{2} + 12x - 1\]

Ab jo bacha, \(12x + 71\), us ki degree 1 hai, jo divisor ki degree 2 se kam hai. Is ko mazeed divide nahi kar sakte, is liye yahi remainder hai aur division yahan ruk jata hai.

\[\begin{array}{rrrrrr}  &  &  & 5x^{2} & -\,3x & -\,18 \\ x^{2} + 4\,\big) & \overline{5x^{4}} & \overline{-\,3x^{3}} & \overline{+\,2x^{2}} & \overline{+\,0x} & \overline{-\,1} \\  & \underline{\pm 5x^{4}} &  & \underline{\pm 20x^{2}} &  &  \\  &  & -3x^{3} & -\,18x^{2} &  & -\,1 \\  &  & \underline{\mp 3x^{3}} &  & \underline{\mp 12x} &  \\  &  &  & -18x^{2} & +\,12x & -\,1 \\  &  &  & \underline{\mp 18x^{2}} &  & \underline{\mp 72} \\  &  &  &  & 12x & +\,71 \end{array}\]
Kyun: Exam mein upar wale saare rounds isi tarah ek hi layout mein likhe jate hain: upar quotient, line ke neeche dividend, aur har round ka product us ke neeche. Product ki har term ke saath \(\pm\) ya \(\mp\) likhte hain: upar wala sign product ka asal sign hai aur neeche wala sign woh hai jo subtract karte waqt ban jata hai. Is se signs badalna bhoolta nahi.

Quotient aur remainder parhein
\[\text{Quotient} = 5x^{2} - 3x - 18\]
\[\text{Remainder} = 12x + 71\]
Kyun: Layout mein sab se upar wali line quotient hai, kyunke har round mein hum ne usi mein ek term jori thi. Sab se neeche wali line ki degree divisor ki degree se kam hai, is liye woh remainder hai. Yaad rakhein: remainder ki degree hamesha divisor ki degree se kam hoti hai; agar barabar ya zyada ho to division adhoora hai.

Tasdeeq: Divisor × Quotient + Remainder
\[(x^{2} + 4)(5x^{2} - 3x - 18)\]
\[= 5x^{4} - 3x^{3} + 2x^{2} - 12x - 72\]
\[\text{add } (12x + 71):\]
\[= 5x^{4} - 3x^{3} + 2x^{2} - 1 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Division ka bunyadi rule hai: Dividend = Divisor × Quotient + Remainder, bilkul jaise \(17 = 5 \times 3 + 2\). Hum ne divisor ko quotient se multiply kiya, remainder joda, aur wapas asal dividend \(5x^{4} - 3x^{3} + 2x^{2} - 1\) mil gaya. Is ka matlab hai ke hamara jawab bilkul sahi hai. Exam mein yeh check do minute leta hai lekin poore marks bacha leta hai.

blocks.prompt: 1 (v) Find remainder and quotient by simplifying the following: \((3x^{4} - 5x^{3} + 4x - 6) \div (x^{2} - 3x + 5)\)
blocks.explanation:
Yeh sawal waisa hi hai jaise hum bachpan mein numbers ki long division karte the, jaise \(17 \div 5\) mein quotient 3 aur remainder 2 aata hai. Bas yahan numbers ki jagah polynomials hain.
Diya kya hai? Dividend (jis ko divide karna hai) \(3x^{4} - 5x^{3} + 4x - 6\) aur divisor (jis se divide karna hai) \(x^{2} - 3x + 5\), jis ki degree 2 hai.
Find kya karna hai? Quotient (division ka jawab) aur remainder (jo aakhir mein bach jaye).
Plan: powers ko tarteeb se likhna, phir teen qadam baar baar: divide, multiply, subtract. Jab bacha hua hissa degree 2 se chhota ho jaye to ruk jana, woh remainder hai.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: dividend \(3x^{4} - 5x^{3} + 4x - 6\), divisor \(x^{2} - 3x + 5\).
Humein find karna hai: quotient aur remainder.
Tareeqa: Long division. Pehli term ko pehli term se divide karna, jawab ko poore divisor se multiply karna, phir subtract karna; yeh chakkar tab tak chalega jab tak bache hue hisse ki degree divisor ki degree 2 se kam na ho jaye. Aakhir mein jawab is rule par poora utrega: Dividend = Divisor × Quotient + Remainder. Isi rule se hum aakhir mein apna jawab check bhi karenge.

Dividend ko tarteeb se likhein
\[3x^{4} - 5x^{3} + 0x^{2} + 4x - 6\]
Kyun: Long division mein har power ka apna column hota hai, bilkul jaise numbers mein ikaai, dahaai, saikra ke columns. Is dividend mein \(x^{2}\) wali term mojood hi nahi, is liye hum us ki jagah 0 coefficient wali term likh dete hain. Is se columns seedhe rehte hain aur subtract karte waqt galat term se galat term nahi katti.
Dhyan dein: Missing power ki jagah khaali chhor dena aur baad mein terms ko ghalat column mein likh dena bohat aam ghalti hai.

Round 1: quotient ki agli term \(3x^{2}\)
Divide, multiply, subtract:
\[\dfrac{3x^{4}}{x^{2}} = 3x^{2}\]
\[3x^{2}(x^{2} - 3x + 5)\]
\[= 3x^{4} - 9x^{3} + 15x^{2}\]
\[3x^{4} - 5x^{3} + 4x - 6\]
\[-(3x^{4} - 9x^{3} + 15x^{2})\]
\[= 4x^{3} - 15x^{2} + 4x - 6\]
Kyun: Dividend ki pehli term \(3x^{4}\) ko divisor ki pehli term \(x^{2}\) se divide kiya to \(3x^{2}\) mila; yeh quotient ki pehli term hai. Isi ko poore divisor se multiply kar ke neeche likha, taake subtract karne par sab se bari power \(x^{4}\) khatam ho jaye. Subtract karte waqt bracket ki har term ka sign badal jata hai, yani minus ke baad bracket khulta hai to plus minus aur minus plus ban jata hai.
Dhyan dein: Sirf pehli term ka sign badal kar baqi bhool jana sab se aam ghalti hai; isi liye hum product ko bracket mein likh kar poora subtract karte hain.

Round 2: quotient ki agli term \(4x\)
Divide, multiply, subtract:
\[\dfrac{4x^{3}}{x^{2}} = 4x\]
\[4x(x^{2} - 3x + 5)\]
\[= 4x^{3} - 12x^{2} + 20x\]
\[4x^{3} - 15x^{2} + 4x - 6\]
\[-(4x^{3} - 12x^{2} + 20x)\]
\[= -3x^{2} - 16x - 6\]
Kyun: Pichhle round ke baad jo bacha us ki degree 3 hai, jo divisor ki degree 2 se kam nahi, is liye division abhi khatam nahi hua. Wohi teen kaam dobara: bachi hui pehli term \(4x^{3}\) ko \(x^{2}\) se divide kiya to \(4x\) mila, phir poore divisor se multiply aur phir subtract. Signs ka khaas khayal rakhein: minus ke saath bracket khulne par andar ki har term ka sign ulat jata hai.

Round 3: quotient ki agli term \(-3\)
Divide, multiply, subtract:
\[\dfrac{-3x^{2}}{x^{2}} = -3\]
\[(-3)(x^{2} - 3x + 5)\]
\[= -3x^{2} + 9x - 15\]
\[-3x^{2} - 16x - 6\]
\[-(-3x^{2} + 9x - 15)\]
\[= -25x + 9\]
Kyun: Pichhle round ke baad jo bacha us ki degree 2 hai, jo divisor ki degree 2 se kam nahi, is liye division abhi khatam nahi hua. Wohi teen kaam dobara: bachi hui pehli term \(-3x^{2}\) ko \(x^{2}\) se divide kiya to \(-3\) mila, phir poore divisor se multiply aur phir subtract. Signs ka khaas khayal rakhein: minus ke saath bracket khulne par andar ki har term ka sign ulat jata hai.
Ab jo bacha, \(-25x + 9\), us ki degree 1 hai, jo divisor ki degree 2 se kam hai. Is ko mazeed divide nahi kar sakte, is liye yahi remainder hai aur division yahan ruk jata hai.

Poori division ko exam wale layout mein likhein
\[\begin{array}{rrrrrr}  &  &  & 3x^{2} & +\,4x & -\,3 \\ x^{2} - 3x + 5\,\big) & \overline{3x^{4}} & \overline{-\,5x^{3}} & \overline{+\,0x^{2}} & \overline{+\,4x} & \overline{-\,6} \\  & \underline{\pm 3x^{4}} & \underline{\mp 9x^{3}} & \underline{\pm 15x^{2}} &  &  \\  &  & 4x^{3} & -\,15x^{2} & +\,4x & -\,6 \\  &  & \underline{\pm 4x^{3}} & \underline{\mp 12x^{2}} & \underline{\pm 20x} &  \\  &  &  & -3x^{2} & -\,16x & -\,6 \\  &  &  & \underline{\mp 3x^{2}} & \underline{\pm 9x} & \underline{\mp 15} \\  &  &  &  & -25x & +\,9 \end{array}\]
Kyun: Exam mein upar wale saare rounds isi tarah ek hi layout mein likhe jate hain: upar quotient, line ke neeche dividend, aur har round ka product us ke neeche. Product ki har term ke saath \(\pm\) ya \(\mp\) likhte hain: upar wala sign product ka asal sign hai aur neeche wala sign woh hai jo subtract karte waqt ban jata hai. Is se signs badalna bhoolta nahi.

Quotient aur remainder parhein
\[\text{Quotient} = 3x^{2} + 4x - 3\]
\[\text{Remainder} = -25x + 9\]
Kyun: Layout mein sab se upar wali line quotient hai, kyunke har round mein hum ne usi mein ek term jori thi. Sab se neeche wali line ki degree divisor ki degree se kam hai, is liye woh remainder hai. Yaad rakhein: remainder ki degree hamesha divisor ki degree se kam hoti hai; agar barabar ya zyada ho to division adhoora hai.

Tasdeeq: Divisor × Quotient + Remainder
\[(x^{2} - 3x + 5)(3x^{2} + 4x - 3)\]
\[= 3x^{4} - 5x^{3} + 29x - 15\]
\[\text{add } (-25x + 9):\]
\[= 3x^{4} - 5x^{3} + 4x - 6 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Division ka bunyadi rule hai: Dividend = Divisor × Quotient + Remainder, bilkul jaise \(17 = 5 \times 3 + 2\). Hum ne divisor ko quotient se multiply kiya, remainder joda, aur wapas asal dividend \(3x^{4} - 5x^{3} + 4x - 6\) mil gaya. Is ka matlab hai ke hamara jawab bilkul sahi hai. Exam mein yeh check do minute leta hai lekin poore marks bacha leta hai.
